# Ledgerline

Invoicing and payment-tracking SaaS for US small independent contractors. Python/FastAPI +
PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, Stripe for payment collection, deployed on a managed host.

## Governance

**Ratified:** v0.1.0 · 2026-08-10 · production floor · modules: a11y (WCAG, legal-mandate) <!-- GI-001 (fact profile) -->

### Principles

- Secrets MUST stay out of the repo (env vars + `.gitignore`); nothing ships to production on a red build (NON-NEGOTIABLE) <!-- GI-003 -->
- Auth, per-account tenant isolation, and input validation at API boundaries — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/security.md` (NON-NEGOTIABLE) <!-- GI-003 -->
- Money correctness: code touching invoice totals, tax, or payment status MUST have tests that block merge AND deploy; Stripe is the source of truth for payment state; money math uses decimal, never float — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/money-domain.md` (NON-NEGOTIABLE) <!-- GI-010 -->
- Testing discipline: coverage ≥80% warning / ≥60% blocking with a non-decreasing ratchet; a smoke test on the money path exists from day one (NON-NEGOTIABLE) <!-- GI-004 -->
- Error handling: failures MUST NOT silently corrupt data; API errors use a consistent JSON shape; stack traces MUST NOT leak to clients — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/error-handling.md` (NON-NEGOTIABLE) <!-- GI-005 -->
- Observability (floor essentials): a `/health` endpoint MUST exist; logs MUST NOT contain PII — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/observability.md` (NON-NEGOTIABLE; deeper observability waived, see ledger) <!-- GI-006 -->
- Accessibility: the frontend MUST meet WCAG 2.1 AA, enforced by an automated a11y check in CI — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/accessibility.md` (NON-NEGOTIABLE, legal-mandate — unwaivable) <!-- GI-024 -->
- Migration safety: destructive or unreviewed schema migrations MUST be blocked; migrations are forward-only and backward-compatible — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/migrations.md` <!-- GI-011 -->
- Database backups (managed Postgres daily + point-in-time restore) MUST be enabled; the restore procedure lives in the runbook <!-- GI-023 -->
- Hexagonal (light): Stripe and other external systems MUST sit behind ports; domain/money logic MUST NOT import SDK or framework types — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/architecture-layers.md` <!-- GI-007 -->
- Single responsibility: a CI complexity cap MUST block overly complex functions — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/code-quality.md` <!-- GI-008 -->
- Dependency discipline: dependencies pinned and justified; `pip-audit` blocks on high/critical — see `.claude/rules/mochiko/dependencies.md` <!-- GI-009 -->
- Operating docs — follow the knowledge-management module (below) <!-- GI-014 -->
- Release gates — no deploy on red; see ledger for the gate table <!-- GI-017 -->

### Technology stack

- Python 3.12 · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · SQLAlchemy + Alembic (migrations) · pydantic (validation/domain) <!-- GI-002 -->
- React frontend · Stripe (payment collection, hosted checkout — no card data on Ledgerline systems) <!-- GI-002 -->
- Managed host (Render or Railway — not yet locked) · GitHub Actions CI <!-- GI-002 -->

### Quality gates

- `ruff check .` MUST pass before merge <!-- GI-008 -->
- `black --check .` MUST pass before merge <!-- GI-002 -->
- `mypy ledgerline/domain` MUST pass before merge (strict on the money/domain package) <!-- GI-004 -->
- `pytest` MUST pass before merge; the money-path tests are blocking with no exception <!-- GI-010 -->
- Coverage ≥60% blocking / ≥80% warning, non-decreasing (`pytest --cov --cov-fail-under=60`) <!-- GI-004 -->
- `gitleaks detect --no-banner` MUST pass (no committed secrets) <!-- GI-003 -->
- `pip-audit` MUST pass with no high/critical vulnerabilities <!-- GI-009 -->
- Frontend a11y check (`eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` + an axe-core check in tests) MUST pass <!-- GI-024 -->

### Governance operations

- Ledger (waivers · amendment policy · exceptions · Three-Part metadata): `.mochiko/memory/governance-ledger.md`
- Amend via `/mochiko:setup` (fact-profile changes — module attach/detach — and un-waives are governance events)
<!-- mochiko:output-style:begin -->
- Writing style — conversation: `full` · reports: `ultra` *(internal agent hand-offs)* · documents: `full`. Terse and plain-English by default. Set any of the three to `off`, `lite`, `full`, or `ultra` and your choice is kept when this section is regenerated; "normal mode" turns it off for one session.
<!-- mochiko:output-style:end -->
- Path-scoped rules inject on **Read**, not Write (observed behavior) — before creating a new file under `ledgerline/`, `tests/`, `frontend/`, `migrations/`, or `.mochiko/specs/`, read the matching `.claude/rules/mochiko/` file or read back the file you created <!-- standing line: emit whenever the set includes any rules file -->
- Operating docs (knowledge-management module): sessions in `.mochiko/brainstorms/` + `index.md`; rulings land in `DECISIONS.md`; open threads in `BACKLOG.md`; direction in `ROADMAP.md`; landing ritual + invariants at `.mochiko/memory/knowledge-management.md`; groom: `mochiko:grooming-operating-docs` <!-- GI-014 -->
- Release gates: no deploy on a red build; money-path tests + migration check + a11y check gate the deploy; rollback via managed-host deploy rollback with expand-then-contract migrations — detail in the ledger <!-- GI-017 -->
<!-- mochiko:governance:end -->
